instruction: Can you help me configure the touchpad to enable two-finger scrolling and tap-to-click functionality?

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because touchpad gesture configuration requires verifying that specific input methods (two-finger scrolling, tap-to-click) actually work, which depends on hardware support and cannot be reliably tested in the VM environment. The VM typically uses mouse input rather than touchpad gestures.
